messages.campaign_fixture.quest.standing.title: Campaign fixture: trust and standing
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.standing.descript: Choose how to treat the mentor and the wardens. Their reactions are personal to each player.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.standing.offer.la: Test personal trust and faction standing
campaign_fixture.quest.standing.offer.li: Speak with the mentor after accepting this fixture quest.
campaign_fixture.quest.standing.reminder: Speak with the mentor. Your choices affect your relationship and your standing with the wardens.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.standing.conversa: Ask the mentor for trusted advice
Ask how the wardens see me
Will you stand with us when the village needs help?
You can count on my help.
Your rivals will hear everything you told me.
I appreciate your support. I will tell the wardens they can count on you.
Then I have misjudged you. The wardens will hear of this.
You have earned my trust. Let us speak openly.
The wardens speak well of you.
